name: exa
label: Exa
description: AI-powered search and content extraction from the web.

find_similar_links.label: Find Similar Links
find_similar_links.description: Find pages similar to a given URL.

url.label: URL
url.description: Reference URL to find semantically similar links.

includeDomains.label: Include Domains
includeDomains.description: List of domains to include in results.

excludeDomains.label: Exclude Domains
excludeDomains.description: List of domains to exclude from results.

startCrawlDate.label: Start Crawl Date (ISO)
startCrawlDate.description: Include links crawled after this date (ISO format).

endCrawlDate.label: End Crawl Date (ISO)
endCrawlDate.description: Include links crawled before this date (ISO format).

startPublishedDate.label: Start Published Date (ISO)
startPublishedDate.description: Only include links published after this date (ISO format).

endPublishedDate.label: End Published Date (ISO)
endPublishedDate.description: Only include links published before this date (ISO format).

includeText.label: Include Text
includeText.description: Strings that must be present in the webpage text (max 1 string of up to 5 words).

excludeText.label: Exclude Text
excludeText.description: Strings that must not be present in the webpage text (max 1 string of up to 5 words).
